decision.summaryForCoordinator: The distinctive attack here is terminological and only a per-gate check catches it. The predecessor role says 'named-corpus', which is right: v1's obligation is OBL-G29-NAMED-CORPUS and there is no g29 named-corpus-catalog artifact anywhere on disk, so 'named-catalog' would have been wrong twice over. The sibling g20-leftover-join.v2, reviewed minutes ago, says 'named-catalog' in the same role slot and is correct there because G20 has both the obligation and the artifact. Two successors, two words, each right for its gate — worth knowing before anyone normalises the family. The owner attack is also worth reporting precisely, because on this row it cannot fail: live DR-G29's owner cell and live DR-117's are both exactly 'Product owner', so taking the register row's value would have produced the right string. On the G20 sibling the equivalent pair differed and only exact equality separated them. The value here is correct and corroborated by the harness's own field, but a passing owner check on this gate is not evidence the right cell was consulted; the attribution by row in registerRowNote is what carries the claim. The successor itself is clean and additive: four of five inherited obligations byte-identical, the fifth a PURE APPEND with its flag unchanged at true, one obligation added at false, and eighteen top-level keys identical including registerRowNote, namedCorpusNotAuthored, namedClassesThisGate, liveGateOwners and doesNot. summary.leftoverDesign is unchanged. Diffing every key surfaced the same summary-shortening pattern as the G20 successor — the not-QUALIFIED standing, the harness-spec sentences and the D-157 EE closure restatement dropped from two prose fields — but every one is still carried in a byte-identical obligation, and unlike G20 nothing dropped concerns a leftover owned by another row, so this instance is milder. The EE census is exact against D-157's grant of seven classes, with EE-3a, EE-6b and G30's EE-7a/7b/7d all absent, which is positive evidence the grant was read. '7.1' occurs six times, the highest in this sequence, and every one is a refusal. All seventeen cited digests match, the harness cited is v2 with v1 referenced nowhere, partition is exact at six obligations, and neither the subject nor v1 moved. Twenty-seven attacks run, twenty-seven refuted, zero findings. Disclosure: all three cited claude2 reviews are my own, two written earlier in this session.
